description: Open-loop scoop trajectory optimized under realistic uncertainty (base accel 1.5 m/s^2, speed +-10%, joint friction, gravity-comp error +-20%, 0-33 ms latency, ball/robot friction + restitution). MIT-mode arm (Kp 10/25, Kd 3, 4 N m, gravity FF), real masses. Ball 1.0 m dead ahead, robot and ball at rest. 97.6% success over 500 randomized runs.

trajectory.units: v m/s from t=0; t_lift s; rate rad/s per joint; d_* rad above initial pose; t_brake s after t_lift; press_elbow N m feedforward before t_lift (negative = head down)
